test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘K % L’ means ‘K is the mother of L’.

‘K @ L’ means ‘K is the brother of L’.

‘K ^ L’ means ‘K is the son of L’.

‘K # L’ means ‘K is the wife of L’. 

If A @ B ^ C # D @ E, how is E related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 @
 ^
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Son
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: A @ B ^ C # D @ E

It means: A is the Brother of B, B is the Son of C, C is the Wife of D, D is the Brother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91150bf8721f53eb4092b3c98853a337a30ed1f856497da4223ad5d1090b0ee0.png] 

Here, E is the 'Father’s brother' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
